# ACL9 Apex

> Academic Formula 1 podium-prediction project showcase. ACL, 9th Semester, Winter 26 (HBOX).

- Planned site: https://acl9-winter26-apex.hatemsoliman.dev
- Repository: https://github.com/CodeNKoffee/acl9-winter26-apex
- Project archive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DqSlh85tX_Q4ai2vMS4IBDJC6TlLHCPO/view?usp=sharing
- Guide: https://github.com/CodeNKoffee/acl9-winter26-apex/tree/main/docs/wiki

The website presents the project brief, anonymous crew disciplines, and archive links. It does not run a prediction model or claim verified model results. The existing ZIP is maintained separately by its owner. Website code uses MIT; third-party media and archive contents are excluded.
